comment: First-load JS in decimal kB (gzip), checked manually (not by CI) by `node scripts/perf-bundle-report.mjs --check` right after `npm run build` on the same tree. Baseline = PA measurement (2026-10-09, lighter first load, on main b141183); ceiling = baseline plus about 2% headroom: a regression guard. The Phase-0 baseline (main 857b159) is in the performance audit evidence. Target = performance plan goal; lower a ceiling only when a change has delivered the reduction.
